types.name: vip.v1.GetVIPStatusRequest
types.doc:
GetVIPStatusRequest requests VIP status for the authenticated caller's root
 account. All subaccounts inherit that root status, so this request has no
 subaccount selector.

types.name: vip.v1.GetVIPStatusResponse
types.doc:
GetVIPStatusResponse contains the authenticated caller-root VIP assignment
 and the qualification facts available for that assignment.

fields.name: tier
fields.doc: Effective VIP tier in the inclusive range 0 through 10.

fields.name: volume_tier
fields.doc:
Tier earned from rolling 30-day settled spot volume, in the inclusive
 range 0 through 10.

fields.name: aop_tier
fields.doc:
Tier earned from rolling 30-day average portfolio value, in the inclusive
 range 0 through 10.

fields.name: settled_volume_30d_usd
fields.doc:
Rolling 30-day settled spot volume in USD, encoded as a non-negative
 base-10 decimal string without separators or a currency symbol. When
 settled_volume_quality.status is PRICE_UNAVAILABLE, this is a lower bound
 that excludes executions without an admissible USD reference price.
 Omitted when settled_volume_quality is omitted or its status is
 INCOMPLETE_HISTORY.

fields.name: average_aop_30d_usd
fields.doc:
Rolling 30-day average portfolio value in USD, encoded as a non-negative
 base-10 decimal string without separators or a currency symbol. Omitted
 unless average_aop_quality.status is COMPLETE.

fields.name: policy_version
fields.doc: Positive identifier of the VIP policy used for this assignment.

fields.name: policy_effective_from
fields.doc: UTC time at which the selected assignment policy became effective.

fields.name: effective_from
fields.doc:
UTC time from which the explicit VIP assignment is effective. Omitted
 while a new account is using the default VIP0 tier.

fields.name: evaluated_at
fields.doc:
UTC time at which the explicit assignment was evaluated. Omitted while a
 new account is using the default VIP0 tier.

fields.name: metrics_as_of
fields.doc:
UTC cutoff of the rolling metrics used for this assignment. Omitted when
 neither settled_volume_30d_usd nor average_aop_30d_usd is present.

fields.name: next_tier_thresholds
fields.doc:
Entry thresholds for the tier immediately above the effective tier.
 Omitted when the effective tier is VIP10.

fields.name: settled_volume_quality
fields.doc:
Completeness of the rolling 30-day settled spot volume. An incomplete
 volume metric can raise the volume tier when its proven lower bound meets
 a higher threshold, but it never lowers the tier. Omitted when the
 assignment carries no automatic qualification evidence, such as the
 default VIP0 tier of a new account.

fields.name: average_aop_quality
fields.doc:
Completeness of the rolling 30-day average portfolio value. An incomplete
 average portfolio value keeps its previous tier. Omitted when the
 assignment carries no automatic qualification evidence, such as the
 default VIP0 tier of a new account.

types.name: vip.v1.ListVIPTiersRequest
types.doc: ListVIPTiersRequest requests the complete active VIP tier catalog.

types.name: vip.v1.ListVIPTiersResponse
types.doc: ListVIPTiersResponse contains one complete, immutable VIP policy version.

fields.name: policy_version
fields.doc: Positive identifier of the returned VIP policy version.

fields.name: effective_from
fields.doc: UTC time at which this policy version became effective.

fields.name: retention_threshold_bp
fields.doc:
Average portfolio value retention threshold in basis points. One basis
 point is 0.01%; valid values are 1 through 10000.

fields.name: tiers
fields.doc:
Complete VIP0 through VIP10 catalog ordered by tier ascending. This is a
 naturally bounded 11-row snapshot and is not paginated.

types.name: vip.v1.NextVIPTierThresholds
types.doc:
NextVIPTierThresholds contains the entry thresholds for the tier immediately
 above the caller's effective tier.

fields.name: tier
fields.doc: Numeric next tier in the inclusive range 1 through 10.

fields.name: volume_threshold_usd
fields.doc:
Rolling 30-day settled spot volume entry threshold in USD, encoded as a
 non-negative base-10 decimal string without separators or a currency
 symbol.

fields.name: aop_threshold_usd
fields.doc:
Rolling 30-day average portfolio value entry threshold in USD, encoded as
 a positive base-10 decimal string without separators or a currency symbol.

types.name: vip.v1.VIPMetricQuality
types.doc:
VIPMetricQuality explains the completeness of one rolling 30-day
 qualification metric.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Completeness status of the metric.

fields.name: incomplete_hours
fields.doc:
Number of hourly buckets in the rolling 720-hour window that are missing
 or incomplete. Zero when status is COMPLETE.

types.name: vip.v1.VIPMetricStatus
types.doc:
VIPMetricStatus describes how complete one rolling 30-day qualification
 metric is.

values.name: COMPLETE
values.doc: Every hour in the rolling window has complete evidence.

values.name: PRICE_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc:
Every hour in the rolling window is present, but some hours contain
 executions or holdings without an admissible USD reference price at the
 required time. Those contributions are not estimated.

values.name: INCOMPLETE_HISTORY
values.doc:
Some hours in the rolling window are missing or contain other incomplete
 evidence.

types.name: vip.v1.VIPTier
types.doc: VIPTier describes one row in a complete VIP0 through VIP10 policy catalog.

fields.name: tier
fields.doc: Numeric VIP tier in the inclusive range 0 through 10.

fields.name: volume_threshold_usd
fields.doc:
Rolling 30-day settled spot volume entry threshold in USD, encoded as a
 non-negative base-10 decimal string without separators or a currency
 symbol.

fields.name: aop_threshold_usd
fields.doc:
Rolling 30-day average portfolio value entry threshold in USD, encoded as
 a positive base-10 decimal string without separators or a currency symbol.
 Omitted for VIP0, which has no average portfolio value entry threshold.

fields.name: maker_fee_rate_percent
fields.doc:
Absolute maker fee rate before symbol-specific adjustments, encoded as a
 base-10 percentage string without a percent sign. Values are between
 -100 and 100 inclusive.

fields.name: taker_fee_rate_percent
fields.doc:
Absolute taker fee rate before symbol-specific adjustments, encoded as a
 non-negative base-10 percentage string without a percent sign. Values are
 between 0 and 100 inclusive.
